name: qfd_tile_nk_a0cv9-a0cv9-COMMIT
purpose: PATH-QC-NK 10-25 a0 v9 (from v8c reset4 r4, autopilot 8fffd9b75f35 FAIL_POSTCTS FF -316.66/2066; STRUCTURAL, no hold buffers/resize/LVT): (1) hard-core clock pins on their own tap assignment: ROM leaf / LSL clock pins -> the flop tap nearest the CLOCK PIN (OT_CORE_TAPS; r4 assigned by instance origin: W leaves rb[0..1] col0 on the flop-free grid tap ck, padded like flops to 259 ps -> leaf registers at 466 ps TT, ROM reset hold -94.64); (2) node (internal 246 TT mean) on a CORE-ONLY tap next to its clock pin: ck_t2 (flop-free grid tap) moved to (75.92, 892.672) and excluded from the flop split (OT_CORE_ONLY_TAPS) -- r4 node shared ck_t28 and CTS balanced its 906 W input pin registers to node pin + ETM insertion = 396 ps; (3) OT_CORE_LAT TT pin-register means (romleaf 206.9 / lsl 165.7 / node 245.9, core_clock_contract_0719; not ETM max) so tap_balance balances core-only taps on effective arrival and keeps cores out of flop statistics; (4) sign-off/hold-gate boundary: io_ref_skew.sdc updates hold timing before reading the reference min arrival (r4 gate read min 0.0 -> every input min delay 0, the -316.66 bulk) and fails closed on min 0. Pins, RTL, placement recipe, reset4 unchanged except the one interior M7 tap ck_t2 site (plan delta a0_core_taps.json NK ck_t2).
